<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Set rowId to the name of a field containing a unique nonempty string per row. Rows without a valid ID or with a repeated ID are omitted. Columns need unique IDs and accessors for JSON fields. Cells render strings, numbers, and booleans. Supply sorting, pageIndex, pageSize, filter, and selectedIds from State and use the corresponding change events. If filtering puts pageIndex out of range, the last page is shown and State remains host-controlled. Selection IDs can outlive their rows. Set `labels` to override the built-in text. Omitted fields use the English defaults. In `selectRow`, `{id}` expands to the row ID. In `page`, `{page}` and `{pages}` expand to the displayed page number and page count. Compose a native Svelte table for custom cells.

## Usage

```ts
import { dataTable } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/data-table';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/data-table`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-datatable"></a>

### `shadcn.DataTable`

This is a JSON composition.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `Array<{ id: string, accessorKey: string, label: string, sortable?: boolean, filterable?: boolean }>` | Default `[]` · `[]` no extra fields |
| `data` | `Array<object>` | Default `[]` |
| `filter` | `string` | Default `""` |
| `pageIndex` | `integer` | Default `0` · minimum 0 |
| `pageSize` | `integer` | Default `10` · minimum 1 |
| `rowId` | `string` | Default `"id"` |
| `selectedIds` | `Array<string>` | Default `[]` |
| `sorting` | `Array<{ id: string, desc: boolean }>` | Default `[]` · `[]` no extra fields |
| `labels` | `{ filter?: string, select?: string, selectRow?: string, noRows?: string, previous?: string, next?: string, page?: string, rowsPerPage?: string }` | no extra fields |

No slots.

| Event | `value` in payload | Codec and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sortingChange` | `Array<{ id: string, desc: boolean }>` | `[]` no extra fields |
| `pageIndexChange` | `number` | — |
| `pageSizeChange` | `number` | — |
| `filterChange` | `string` | — |
| `selectedIdsChange` | `Array<string>` | — |

#### Example View

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "example",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.DataTable",
    "inputs": {
      "rowId": "code",
      "data": [
        {
          "code": "weekly",
          "report": "Weekly report",
          "count": 17
        }
      ],
      "columns": [
        {
          "id": "report",
          "accessorKey": "report",
          "label": "Report"
        },
        {
          "id": "count",
          "accessorKey": "count",
          "label": "Count",
          "sortable": true
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
